name: electron-with-cpp
description: Electron + Vue 2 desktop application with a cross-platform C++ core loaded through koffi
author: ElectronWithCpp

scripts.pack: npm run build && npm run build:native && electron-builder --dir --config electron-builder.config.cjs
scripts.dist: npm run build && npm run build:native && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs
scripts.dist:win: npm run build && npm run build:native && electron-builder --win nsis --config electron-builder.config.cjs
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build && npm run build:native && electron-builder --mac dmg --config electron-builder.config.cjs
scripts.dist:linux: npm run build && npm run build:native && electron-builder --linux AppImage --config electron-builder.config.cjs
